svg.text: The KV cache is split into small fixed-size blocks (here 4 tokens each). A block table maps each request to its blocks.
A free block (3) is taken for the 3 prompt tokens.
Block 3 still had a free slot: no new memory needed.
Block 3 is full, so any free block is used (6). It does not need to be next to block 3.
Memory grows one block at a time, only when needed.
